title: Scholarship Unlocked
description: Your grades finally paid off. Literally.

title: Free Pizza Seminar
description: You came for the pizza. A guy in a shiny suit offers a 'guaranteed 300% return'.

options.name: Invest
options.description: The guy and your money both disappeared. The pizza was cold.

options.name: Just Eat the Pizza
options.description: Free lunch, zero regrets. Financial literacy +1.

title: Laptop Down
description: Coffee meets keyboard two days before the deadline.

title: Roommate Ghosted
description: Moved out at 3 AM. Took the toaster. Left you the rent.

title: Summer Job Abroad
description: Three months of picking strawberries. Your back hates you, your account loves you.

title: First Real Paycheck
description: An actual salary hits your account. It's whispering 'treat yourself'.

options.name: Treat Yourself
options.description: New shoes, new phone, new you. Same old account balance.

options.name: Save It
options.description: Responsible. Boring. Future-you approves.

title: Used Car Deal
description: A 2009 hatchback, 'only' 240,000 km, previous owner 'a careful grandma'.

options.name: Buy It
options.description: Freedom on four wheels. Mostly four.

options.name: Walk Away
options.description: Bus pass it is. Your wallet sends a thank-you note.

title: Tax Refund
description: The tax office owes YOU money. Frame the letter.

title: Wedding Season
description: Five friends, five weddings, five envelopes. Your liver and wallet both file complaints.

title: Parcel Scam
description: 'Your parcel is waiting, pay 1.99 to release it.' You paid. So did your whole account.

title: Burst Pipe
description: The new house came with a free indoor pool. Ground floor only.

title: Interest Rate Hike
description: The central bank sneezed. Your mortgage caught a cold.

title: Barbecue Legend
description: Your garden party becomes neighbourhood folklore. Friends unlocked.

title: Side Hustle
description: A friend offers you weekend work. Extra cash, fewer lazy Sundays.

options.name: Take It
options.description: Money in, free time out.

options.name: Keep Weekends Free
options.description: Your couch and your sanity thank you.

title: Distant Aunt's Will
description: You met her twice. She left you a vase and a surprising amount of money.

title: Daycare Waitlist
description: You're number 147 on the list. Private daycare it is.

title: Grandparents to the Rescue
description: Free childcare! The kid now eats only sweets.

title: Baby Shower Haul
description: Three strollers, zero sleep, one very generous aunt.

title: Burnout Alert
description: You just tried to log in to the microwave.

options.name: Take a Vacation
options.description: Sun, sea, and nobody asking for a report.

options.name: Push Through
options.description: Productivity: high. Soul: missing.

title: Surprise Bank Fee
description: Your 'free' account now charges a fee for... having an account.

title: The Charming Stranger
description: At a conference, a suspiciously charming stranger is very interested in your evening plans. And your work passwords.

options.name: Have a Drink With Her
options.description: Great evening. Turns out she was a spy. Your savings and your marriage both need a lawyer.

options.name: Go Back to the Hotel
options.description: You call your wife and fall asleep at 9 PM. Unhackable.

title: Annual Bonus
description: One extra month of salary! The kid's braces already have plans for it.

title: The 75-Inch Temptation
description: Black Friday. A TV the size of your wall is on sale.

options.name: Buy It
options.description: The football has never looked this good. The account has never looked this bad.

options.name: Keep the Old One
options.description: It still works. Mostly.

title: School Trip Season
description: Ski trip, language camp, and 'everyone else has the new phone'.

title: Hatchback Says Goodbye
description: Your trusty old car died on the motorway. Rest in pieces.

title: The Property Ladder
description: A modern home is finally within reach. The mortgage calculator looks less excited than you do.

options.name: Buy the Modern Home
options.description: More space, more comfort, and a very long relationship with the bank.

options.name: Stay Where You Are
options.description: A bigger house can wait until the numbers make sense.

title: Keyed Convertible
description: Someone scratched the convertible. Insurance calls it 'cosmetic'.

title: Doctor Says Move
description: Your doctor suggests exercise. Your knees suggest otherwise.

options.name: Gym Membership
options.description: Expensive, sweaty, surprisingly great.

options.name: Walk More
options.description: Free, slow, and you finally meet your neighbours.

title: Dividend Day
description: Your boring index fund quietly paid out. Boring is beautiful.

title: Roof Repair
description: The roof leaks. The quotes leak even more.

title: High School Reunion
description: Everyone is either a CEO or 'between projects'.

options.name: Pay for the Whole Round
options.description: Legend status for one night.

options.name: Stay Home
options.description: No flexing, no hangover.

title: Panicked Neighbour
description: Your neighbour sold everything at the bottom. Now he wants to borrow money.

options.name: Lend Him Money
options.description: Good neighbour, questionable investor.

options.name: Say No
options.description: Awkward at the fence for a few months.

title: Grand Theft Convertible
description: Your convertible found a new owner. He didn't ask. Insurance covers half.

title: Braces 2.0
description: The kid's teeth need round two. The orthodontist bought a boat.

title: Lottery Mini Win
description: Four numbers! It only took ten years of 'just this once'.

title: The Rebound
description: You held. The market bounced back. Your nerves didn't, but your portfolio did.

title: A Home for the Next Chapter
description: You've built a life in your modern home. An upgrade would be lovely, if the budget agrees.

options.name: Upgrade to the Modern Home
options.description: A lasting upgrade for the home you've worked toward.

options.name: Keep Your Current Home
options.description: Your current home still fits your plans.

title: Boomerang Kid
description: The kid moved back in. With a partner. And a cat.

title: Health Check-Up
description: The clinic invites you for a full check-up.

options.name: Do All the Tests
options.description: Peace of mind costs a bit, but it's worth it.

options.name: Skip It
options.description: 'I feel fine' is not a medical test.

title: Your Kid's Wedding
description: Now YOU pay for the uncle dancing to the same song 7 times.

title: Grandkid Arrives
description: All the fun, none of the night shifts.

title: Early Retirement Offer
description: Your company offers a package to leave early.

options.name: Take the Package
options.description: Big cheque now, smaller pension later.

options.name: Stay
options.description: Five more years of meetings that could have been emails.

title: Safe Account Scam
description: A 'bank advisor' urgently needs to move your savings to a 'safe account'.

options.name: Follow Instructions
options.description: Your savings are now very safe. In someone else's account.

options.name: Hang Up and Call Your Bank
options.description: Scam detected. You feel like a cyber-security expert.

title: Mortgage Paid Off
description: The bank finally sent a letter that isn't a threat.

title: Bond Coupon
description: Your safe, boring bonds paid out. Grandpa energy, grandpa money.

title: Retirement Calculator
description: You finally opened it. It laughed at you.

title: One Last Big Trip
description: The world is big and your knees still work. For now.

options.name: Go Travel
options.description: Memories for life, photos for everyone at Christmas.

options.name: Stay Home
options.description: Saved money, saw the same four walls.
